figures.alt: Florida room addition with new slab, plumbing stubs, framed walls, HVAC connection, and existing-home tie-in
figures.caption: An addition starts with a real connection between old and new: foundation, framing, utilities, HVAC, roof, and drainage. The scope has to resolve those interfaces before finish choices take over.

figures.alt: Planning table with abstract drawings, ruler, and estimating tools
figures.caption: Define scope, setbacks, utilities, permit needs, and finish priorities before construction begins. A clear planning phase prevents the addition from becoming a chain of late decisions.

figures.alt: Florida home addition framing meeting an existing stucco wall at a layered roof tie-in
figures.caption: Roof and wall integration are high-consequence addition details. Resolve flashing, framing, windows, and drainage as one assembly before the work is covered.
